name: Infernal Mason
backstory:
Before the Shadow-Cursed Lands were overcome by Shar's curse, the Infernal Mason was a Selûnite named Morfred. Morfred worked at Reithwin Town's mason guild, under his master the great general Ketheric Thorm. 

The town was originally home to many Selûnites, including Ketheric and his family. It was the Mason who was the original architect of Moonrise Towers, a grand symbol of devotion to Selûne.

After the death of his daughter, Ketheric turned to Shar and built up an army of Dark Justiciars. Morfred witnessed Ketheric's descent, growing his army and rooting out every last trace of Selûne in Reithwin, until eventually Morfred and his brother Halfred were the last remaining Selûnite leaders in the town, joined by worshippers in secret.

Tired of standing by as Ketheric and his Justiciars overtook the town, Morfred's despair caught the attention of Raphael, who took notice and approached him with an infernal pact: his soul in exchange for the Justiciars complete destruction.

Raphael honoured his deal by sending Yurgir and his merregons, who slaughtered all but one Justiciar. Without his army, and routed by the Harpers, Ketheric released the Shadow Curse in a final act of desperation.

Morfred died some time later and became a debtor, bound to the House of Hope.
